Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0027 2026-05-20
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-05-20
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0020, TEAM-0002
Subject: BETA Weekend Contact Rounds at Station 01
Decision: From 2026-05-23, DEMO-STATION-01 will hold weekend
queue-contact rounds at 10:00 and 14:00 for DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA. The
roster clerk must name the coordinator for each interval before the preceding
weekday handover.
The duty chair supplies a fallback role if the scheduled coordinator becomes
unavailable. Record the uncovered interval and substitute on the roster sheet;
do not rely on the next person walking past the desk. The weekend
arrangement covers intake questions, reviewer appointments, and the location
of requested papers.
The daily reply window remains at 18:30. Keep it distinct from the contact
rounds: the window gathers promised responses, while the rounds arrange the
next administrative contacts. The station clerk holds the window when the
usual coordinator is absent.
Use ISSUE-0175, TASK-0466, and TASK-0467 as locating references for the
cabin folder during roster training. The example demonstrates how to carry a
reference through a coverage interval without changing task assignments.
Implementation: PERSON-0020 will give the roster clerk the revised coverage
sheet on 2026-05-21. The station coordinator will review the sheet after the
first weekend and record any interval that needs a clearer fallback. File the
original roster beside the review note so later shifts can understand the
coverage decision.
D. Worker 0020
Demo Worker 0020, Demo Team 02
